note: The Republic of the Congo: work for up to six months takes the temporary work authorisation, non-renewable, without which no one may work; longer work the work permit, two years and renewable, on a contract registered with the Agence Congolaise pour l'Emploi. No days without one. From an immigration firm's country page.

sources.title: Newland Chase, Congo (Brazzaville) Immigration Services
sources.said: (l'autorisation de travail temporaire) is issued to applicants intending to work in Congo Brazzaville for up to six months and is non-renewable. ... The applicant may not legally work in Congo until the temporary authorisation is obtained.
